purpose: Evaluate whether the Playwright skill should be selected for browser automation, E2E tests, traces, headed/debug runs, and CMS UI validation.

testCases.prompt: Run the full Playwright E2E suite with tester/pw and tell me if all tests pass.
expectedBehaviors: Use the Playwright E2E workflow.
Set PLAYWRIGHT_LOGIN_NAME and PLAYWRIGHT_PASSWORD before running tests.
Run npm run test:e2e.
Report passed, failed, or skipped tests.

testCases.prompt: Start a headed Playwright run so I can watch the browser click through the app.
expectedBehaviors: Use the headed E2E command.
Run npm run test:e2e:headed with the configured credentials.
Mention that a visible Chromium window may open.

testCases.prompt: The Page CRUD test failed. Open or explain the trace and help diagnose the failure.
expectedBehaviors: Inspect test-results trace or error context files when available.
Use npx playwright show-trace when the user wants the trace viewer.
Diagnose selector, timing, network, or UI state issues.

testCases.prompt: Add an E2E test for creating, editing, and deleting templates in the admin UI.
expectedBehaviors: Inspect the existing UI and API contract before writing the test.
Use user-visible selectors where possible.
Create isolated e2e records with unique names.
Run the targeted test and npm run build after changes.

testCases.prompt: Use the browser to open /login and check console and network errors.
expectedBehaviors: Use Playwright browser automation or MCP validation.
Open the requested route.
Inspect console messages and network requests.
Report expected auth 401 responses separately from real errors.

testCases.prompt: Verify that login and registration do not show CAPTCHA when the backend config disables CAPTCHA.
expectedBehaviors: Check /api/auth/config.
Validate login and registration UI behavior.
Ensure /api/auth/captcha is not requested when CAPTCHA is disabled.

testCases.prompt: Start the frontend dev server and tell me which URL to open.
expectedBehaviors: Use the CMS frontend dev runtime skill instead of the Playwright skill.

testCases.prompt: Update the User API TypeScript types for a backend field rename.
expectedBehaviors: Do not select Playwright unless browser validation or E2E testing is requested.
